name: Search API OpenSearch Semantic
description: extends Search API OpenSearch with vector (semantic) search.
project_description:
This module is an extension to the Search API OpenSearch module that provides support for semantic search capabilities.

 Specifically, it utilizes the semantic field added in OpenSearch 3.1.

 This is an experimental development module and requires an understanding of how to set up OpenSearch to use ML models. It is expected this will be done outside this module and a model ID is available to be set in this modules settings.

 See Integrating ML models for more information.
